predictions.selection_reason: cookie parsing callback parameter renamed to ignoreErr -> may indicate error suppression in authentication flow
predictions.source_summary: Cookies from WebSocket upgrade request headers (this._ws.upgradeReq.headers.cookie). The cookies contain authentication state stored by the server.
predictions.sink_summary: Authentication state extraction: state[config.cookie] -> this.auth credentials and artifacts. Used later for subscription authorization checks.
predictions.guard_summary: Authentication config check (lines 379-382). Cookie presence check (lines 384-387). Subscription-time auth checks in listener._subscribe (lines 306-348) verify credentials and scope if auth mode is 'required'. No error handling for cookie parsing failures - error parameter named 'ignoreErr' and not used.
predictions.risk_pattern: Cookie parsing errors are ignored in authentication callback. If cookie parsing fails (tampered, malformed, or corrupted data), authentication may silently fail, potentially leaving socket without proper auth state while not reporting error.
predictions.context_summary: In _authenticate method called during WebSocket connection setup. Parses cookies to extract authentication state. Sets this.auth if valid auth cookie found. Error from parse callback is ignored (parameter named ignoreErr).
unresolved_facts: Exact behavior of states.parse on error: whether it calls callback with null/empty state, what 'failed' parameter indicates
Whether other parts of system properly handle missing this.auth when auth is required
Whether cookie parsing failures could lead to authentication bypass or only to failed authentication

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: cookie parsing error ignored, authentication state may be incorrectly set or missing, leading to missing control
retrieval_query.source: cookies from WebSocket upgrade request headers
